title: Chapter 15 – Puruṣottama Yoga (The Yoga of the Supreme Person)
subtitle: Yoga of the Supreme Being

verses.title: 15.1 urdhva-mulam adhah
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम् ।
छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित् ॥ १५-१॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
ūrdhvamūlamadhaḥśākhamaśvatthaṃ prāhuravyayam
chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit 15-1
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
uurdhva muulam adhah shaakham ashvattham praahuh avyayam
chandaamsi yasya parnaani yah tam veda sa vedavit 15-1
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: The wise describe the indestructible Ashwattha tree as having its roots above and its branches below, with the Vedas for its leaves. Whoever understands this tree is the true knower of the Vedas.

verses.title: 15.2 adhash chordhvam
verses.sanskrit:
अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा
गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः ।
अधश्च मूलान्यनुसन्ततानि
कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके ॥ १५-२॥
verses.roman:
adhaścordhvaṃ prasṛtāstasya śākhā
guṇapravṛddhā viṣayapravālāḥ
adhaśca mūlānyanusantatāni
karmānubandhīni manuṣyaloke 15-2
verses.colloquial:
adhashcha uurdhvam prasritaah tasya shaakhaa
guna pravriddhaa vishaya pravaalaah
adhah cha muulaani anusantataani
karma anubandhiini manushya loke 15-2
verses.translation_reworded: Its branches reach downward and upward, fed by the gunas, and the objects of the senses are its buds. Down below, in the world of human beings, its roots spread out, and they spring from action.

verses.title: 15.3 na rupam asyeha
verses.sanskrit:
न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते
नान्तो न चादिर्न च सम्प्रतिष्ठा ।
अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूलं
असङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा ॥ १५-३॥
verses.roman:
na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate
nānto na cādirna ca sampratiṣṭhā
aśvatthamenaṃ suvirūḍhamūlaṃ
asaṅgaśastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā 15-3
verses.colloquial:
na ruupam asya iha tathaa upalabhyate
naantah na cha aadih na cha sampratishthaa
ashvattham enam suviruudha muulam
asanga shastrena dridhena chittvaa 15-3
verses.translation_reworded: Here its form cannot be seen as it really is, nor its end, nor its beginning, nor its foundation, nor where it rests. Once this deep-rooted Ashwattha tree has been cut down with the sturdy axe of non-attachment...

verses.title: 15.4 tatah padam tat
verses.sanskrit:
ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्यं
यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः ।
तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये ।
यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी ॥ १५-४॥
verses.roman:
tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyaṃ
yasmingatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ
tameva cādyaṃ puruṣaṃ prapadye
yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī 15-4
verses.colloquial:
tatah padam tat parimaargitavyam
yasmin gataa na nivartanti bhuuyah
tam eva chaadyam purusham prapadye
yatah pravrittih prasritaa puraanii 15-4
verses.translation_reworded: ...then one should seek out that Goal from which no one who reaches it ever comes back. I take refuge in that primeval Purusha, from whom all activity (or energy) has flowed since time without beginning.

verses.title: 15.5 nirmana-moha
verses.sanskrit:
निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा
अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः ।
द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै-
र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत् ॥ १५-५॥
verses.roman:
nirmānamohā jitasaṅgadoṣā
adhyātmanityā vinivṛttakāmāḥ
dvandvairvimuktāḥ sukhaduḥkhasaṃjñai-
rgacchantyamūḍhāḥ padamavyayaṃ tat 15-5
verses.colloquial:
nirmaana mohaa jita sanga doshaa
adhyaatma nityaa vinivritta kaamaah
dvandvair vimuktaah sukha duhkha samjnai-
rgacchanti amuudhaah padam avyayam tat 15-5
verses.translation_reworded: Free of pride and delusion, having conquered the evil of attachment, always dwelling in the Self, their desires fully withdrawn, released from the pairs of opposites such as pleasure and pain, those who are no longer deluded reach that eternal Goal.

verses.title: 15.6 na tad bhasayate suryo
verses.sanskrit:
न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः ।
यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥ १५-६॥
verses.roman:
na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ
yadgatvā na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama 15-6
verses.colloquial:
na tad bhaasayate suuryo na shashaanko na paavakah
yad gatvaa na nivartante tad dhaama paramam mama 15-6
verses.translation_reworded: The sun does not shine there, nor the moon, nor fire. Those who go there do not return. That is My Supreme Abode.

verses.title: 15.7 mamaivansho jiva-loke
verses.sanskrit:
ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः ।
मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति ॥ १५-७॥
verses.roman:
mamaivāṃśo jīvaloke jīvabhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ
manaḥṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛtisthāni karṣati 15-7
verses.colloquial:
mama eva amsho jiivaloke jiiva bhuutah sanaatanah
manah shashtha aani indriyaani prakriti sthaani karshati 15-7
verses.translation_reworded: An eternal fragment of Myself becomes the living soul in the world of the living. Dwelling in Prakriti, it draws to itself the (five) senses, with the mind as the sixth.

verses.title: 15.8 shariram yad avapnoti
verses.sanskrit:
शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः ।
गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात् ॥ १५-८॥
verses.roman:
śarīraṃ yadavāpnoti yaccāpyutkrāmatīśvaraḥ
gṛhītvaitāni saṃyāti vāyurgandhānivāśayāt 15-8
verses.colloquial:
shariiram yad avaapnoti yacchaapi utkraamati iishvarah
grihiitvaa etaani samyaati vaayuh gandhaan iva aashayaat 15-8
verses.translation_reworded: When the Lord takes on a body, and again when He leaves it, He carries these along with Him, just as the wind carries scents away from their source (the flowers).

verses.title: 15.9 shrotram chakshuh
verses.sanskrit:
श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च ।
अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते ॥ १५-९॥
verses.roman:
śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva ca
adhiṣṭhāya manaścāyaṃ viṣayānupasevate 15-9
verses.colloquial:
shrotram chakshuh sparshanam cha rasanam ghraanam eva cha
adhishthaaya manah cha ayam vishayaan upasevate 15-9
verses.translation_reworded: Ruling over hearing, sight, touch, taste, and smell, and over the mind as well, He experiences the objects of the senses.

verses.title: 15.10 utkramantam sthitam
verses.sanskrit:
उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम् ।
विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः ॥ १५-१०॥
verses.roman:
utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vāpi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitam
vimūḍhā nānupaśyanti paśyanti jñānacakṣuṣaḥ 15-10
verses.colloquial:
utkraamantam sthitam vaapi bhunjaanam vaa guna anvitam
vimuudhaa na anupashyanti pashyanti jnaana chakshushah 15-10
verses.translation_reworded: The deluded do not see Him as He departs, as He stays, and as He enjoys, joined with the gunas. But those who have the eye of Knowledge do see Him.

verses.title: 15.11 yatanto yoginash
verses.sanskrit:
यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम् ।
यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः ॥ १५-११॥
verses.roman:
yatanto yoginaścainaṃ paśyantyātmanyavasthitam
yatanto'pyakṛtātmāno nainaṃ paśyantyacetasaḥ 15-11
verses.colloquial:
yatanto yoginash chainam pashyanti aatmani avasthitam
yatantah api akritaatmaanah na enam pashyanti achetasah 15-11
verses.translation_reworded: Seekers who strive (for Perfection) see Him dwelling in the Self. The unrefined and the unintelligent, however hard they try, do not see Him.

verses.title: 15.12 yad aditya-gatam tejo
verses.sanskrit:
यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम् ।
यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम् ॥ १५-१२॥
verses.roman:
yadādityagataṃ tejo jagadbhāsayate'khilam
yaccandramasi yaccāgnau tattejo viddhi māmakam 15-12
verses.colloquial:
yad aaditya gatam tejo jagat bhaasayate 'khilam
yac chandramasi yac chaagnau tat tejo viddhi maamakam 15-12
verses.translation_reworded: The Light that lives in the sun and lights up the whole world, the Light in the moon and in fire: know that Light to be Mine.

verses.title: 15.13 gam avishya cha bhutani
verses.sanskrit:
गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा ।
पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः ॥ १५-१३॥
verses.roman:
gāmāviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayāmyahamojasā
puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ 15-13
verses.colloquial:
gaam aavishya cha bhuutaani dhaarayaami aham ojasaa
pushnaami cha aushadhiih sarvaah somah bhuutvaa rasa aatmakah 15-13
verses.translation_reworded: Entering the earth, I hold up all beings by (My) energy. Becoming the watery moon, I nourish every plant.

verses.title: 15.14 aham vaishvanaro bhutva
verses.sanskrit:
अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः ।
प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम् ॥ १५-१४॥
verses.roman:
ahaṃ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṃ dehamāśritaḥ
prāṇāpānasamāyuktaḥ pacāmyannaṃ caturvidham 15-14
verses.colloquial:
aham vaishvaanaro bhuutvaa praaninaam deham aashritah
praana apaana samaayuktah pachaami annam chatur vidham 15-14
verses.translation_reworded: Becoming (the Fire) Vaishvaanara, I live in the bodies of beings, and joined with Prana and Apana I digest the four kinds of food.

verses.title: 15.15 sarvasya chaham hridi
verses.sanskrit:
सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो
मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनञ्च ।
वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो
वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम् ॥ १५-१५॥
verses.roman:
sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭo
mattaḥ smṛtirjñāna mapohanañca
vedaiśca sarvairahameva vedyo
vedāntakṛd vedavideva cāham 15-15
verses.colloquial:
sarvasya chaaham hridi sannivishto
mattah smritir jnaana mapohanancha
vedaishcha sarvair aham eva vedyo
vedaanta krid veda vid eva chaaham 15-15
verses.translation_reworded: I am seated in the hearts of all. From Me come memory and knowledge, and their loss as well. I am truly what all the Vedas seek to know; I am the author of Vedanta, and I am the one who knows the Vedas.

verses.title: 15.16 dvav imau purushau
verses.sanskrit:
द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च ।
क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते ॥ १५-१६॥
verses.roman:
dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca
kṣaraḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate 15-16
verses.colloquial:
dvaavimau purushau loke ksharash cha akshara eva cha
ksharah sarvaani bhuutaani kuutasthah akshara uchyate 15-16
verses.translation_reworded: There are two Purushas in this world: the Perishable and the Imperishable. All beings are the Perishable, and the Kootasthah is called the Imperishable.

verses.title: 15.17 uttamah purushas tv
verses.sanskrit:
उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः ।
यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः ॥ १५-१७॥
verses.roman:
uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥ
yo lokatrayamāviśya bibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ 15-17
verses.colloquial:
uttamah purushas tv anyah paramaatmaa iti udaahritah
yo loka trayam aavishya bibharti avyaya iishvarah 15-17
verses.translation_reworded: But different from both is the Supreme Purusha, called the Highest Self, the Indestructible Lord, who pervades and sustains the three worlds (waking, dream, and deep sleep).

verses.title: 15.18 yasmat ksharam atito
verses.sanskrit:
यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः ।
अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥ १५-१८॥
verses.roman:
yasmātkṣaramatīto'hamakṣarādapi cottamaḥ
ato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ 15-18
verses.colloquial:
yasmaat ksharam atiitah aham aksharaad api cha uttamah
ato'smi loke vede cha prathitah purusha uttamah 15-18
verses.translation_reworded: Because I am beyond the perishable and higher even than the Imperishable, I am proclaimed in the world and in the Vedas as the Purushottama (the Highest Purusha).

verses.title: 15.19 yo mam evam asammudho
verses.sanskrit:
यो मामेवमसम्मूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम् ।
स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत ॥ १५-१९॥
verses.roman:
yo māmevamasammūḍho jānāti puruṣottamam
sa sarvavidbhajati māṃ sarvabhāvena bhārata 15-19
verses.colloquial:
yo maam evam asammuudho jaanaati purushottamam
sa sarvavid bhajati maam sarvabhaavena bhaarata 15-19
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever, free of delusion, knows Me in this way as the Supreme Purusha, knows everything, and worships Me with his whole being, O Bharata.

verses.title: 15.20 iti guhyatamam shastram
verses.sanskrit:
इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयानघ ।
एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत ॥ १५-२०॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुन संवादे
पुरुषोत्तमयोगो नाम पञ्चदशोऽध्यायः ॥ १५॥
verses.roman:
iti guhyatamaṃ śāstram idamuktaṃ mayānagha
etadbuddhvā buddhimānsyāt kṛtakṛtyaśca bhārata 15-20

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjuna saṃvāde
puruṣottamayogo nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ 15
verses.colloquial:
iti guhyatamam shaastram idam uktam mayaanagha
etad buddhvaa buddhimaan syaat kritakrityash cha bhaarata

om tat sat iti shriimad bhagavad giitaasu upanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
purushottama yogo naama panchadasho'dhyaayah 15
verses.translation_reworded:
So I have taught you this most secret science (teaching), O sinless one. Understanding it, (a person) becomes wise, and all his duties are fulfilled, O Bharata.

So ends the fifteenth discourse, called "The Yoga of the Supreme Person," in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna.
